workflows.title: Article to presentation
workflows.summary: Create an editorial web article and adapt its evidence into a presentation.

stages.title: Produce the source article
stages.task: Write the approved article with traceable claims and export a stable content outline.

stages.title: Adapt to presentation scenes
stages.task: Use that outline as input; review story, scene outline and rendered presentation at separate checkpoints.

workflows.requirements: Vite, React and TypeScript for generated projects. Optional TTS requires separate services; source skills are Chinese.
workflows.conflicts: Pass an article/outline between stages, not conflicting project scaffolds. Use separate output directories. Adapt upstream agent/reviewer instructions to your host; do not assume subagents or voice services exist.
workflows.compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

workflows.title: Clear website interactions
workflows.summary: Make controls discoverable, then specify honest feedback and recovery states.

stages.title: Clarify the action and outcome
stages.task: Audit one user journey; hand off a control map with labels, expected outcomes, constraints and recovery paths.

stages.title: Specify and implement the state transitions
stages.task: Use the approved control map to define idle, focus, pending, success, failure and repeated-click behavior. Hand off a state matrix and keyboard/reduced-motion checks.

workflows.requirements: A website or prototype with a specific task. Plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript works; no animation runtime or service is bundled. Review source before use; preserve existing project instructions.
workflows.conflicts: Design of Everyday Things owns discoverability and task flow; Microinteractions owns local feedback within that flow. Optional sibling skills are not bundled. Numeric self-scores and user-study percentages are heuristics, not test results. Never show success before the real operation succeeds or infer that copying a command ran it.
workflows.compatibility: Upstream-claimed Codex support for members; static library-authored sequence. No end-to-end test in Codex or Claude.

workflows.title: Evidence to editorial report
workflows.summary: Evaluate provided evidence before turning it into a readable web report.

stages.title: Appraise supplied evidence
stages.task: Create a source/claim/limitation table from user-provided papers; core appraisal only, no optional schematic service.

stages.title: Publish the bounded conclusions
stages.task: Use the approved evidence table to build an editorial article; keep uncertainty, references and missing evidence visible.

workflows.requirements: User-provided sources; frontend tooling for article output. No database retrieval, paid figures or TTS is included.
workflows.conflicts: Critical-thinking owns claim strength; article design must not inflate certainty. Optional sibling skills are excluded. This is not a clinical recommendation workflow.
workflows.compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

workflows.title: Industrial interface + motion
workflows.summary: Apply a deliberate monochrome identity, then add restrained interaction.

stages.title: Set the visual system
stages.task: Apply Nothing-inspired styling only when explicitly requested; record tokens and readable contrast.

stages.title: Add functional motion
stages.task: Animate only interactions justified by the brief; preserve reduced-motion behavior.

workflows.requirements: A web project and GSAP runtime. Optional external fonts need separate setup.
workflows.conflicts: Keep nothing-design as the visual owner; GSAP only owns animation. Codex compatibility of nothing-design is unknown. Do not let motion change the typography or layout.
workflows.compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

workflows.title: React motion studio
workflows.summary: Build scoped, sequenced React animations with lifecycle cleanup.

stages.title: Establish animation primitives
stages.task: Choose targets and tweens; document reduced-motion alternatives.

stages.title: Compose the sequence
stages.task: Create named labels and intentional timing from the approved motion brief.

stages.title: Integrate and verify cleanup
stages.task: Use scoped refs and useGSAP; check rerenders, unmount and reduced motion.

workflows.requirements: React, gsap and @gsap/react. Runtime library terms are separate from skill MIT licenses.
